• Update (November 20, 2026). Checked before faculty review. Sources: every statistic, clinical value, date and regional fact that needs a source was checked against it; wrong numbers were corrected, weak or broken sources were replaced with government, journal and local primary sources (CDC, NIH, FDA, USDA, CDFA, the Fresno County Crop & Livestock Report, the Almond Board’s Almond Almanac), and citations were added where a number had none. The adapted step lists in 13.5 and 14.3 were rewritten, and the figure credits in 14.4 now name their real source. Accessibility: Figure 11.1.1 (alcohol dehydrogenase) is back; tables and figures that scroll sideways on a phone can now be reached and scrolled with the keyboard, and each is named for a screen reader; the “Answer” buttons are larger and show an arrow; small fixes in 3.7, 5.2, 11.6, 12.2, 12.3 and 15.4. An automated WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA scan of every page now finds no problems in the book’s own content.
  • Update (November 17, 2026).
